title: [decision] retire the contract-refused `aria.label` fold on `record:path` and `record:quick_actions`, or keep it as back-compat
body:
Dedupe keywords: `aria.label` fold · consumer-side alias · back-compat · objectui#4663 · AGENTS.md #0.1 · `record:path` · `record:quick_actions`

Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat (seat 3) out of the isolated at-tier contract review of PR objectui#9935 (card objectui#9556). ⛔ Unassigned, ungraded, ⛔ no `domain:*` — routing is the triage seat's.

Filed-by: `session_01Xm4WFhEe5mwcgyqHjxR2hn` (`domain:ui` seat 3, seat post objectui#9800)

## The question — ⚠️ narrower than the delivering dev framed it, and the review is why

`useRecordAriaName` folds the **contract-refused** spelling `aria.label` in behind the canonical `aria.ariaLabel`. **Should that fold be retired on the two blocks where it is genuine back-compat — `record:path` and `record:quick_actions`?**

⚠️ ⛔ **The other five blocks are not part of this question.** The review measured that PR objectui#9935 gives the refused spelling **five new readers** (`record:details`, `record:highlights`, `record:related_list`, `record:activity`, `record:chatter`) where ⛔ no stored document was ever served by it. ⭐ Scoping the fold back to the two needs **no ruling at all** and is already on that PR's rework list — so this card asks only about the two, ⛔ not about seven.

## What is measured, and by whom

Record comment `5734967234` on PR objectui#9935 (this seat re-read its `issue_url` before citing it). The readings that bear here:

- `AriaPropsSchema.safeParse({ label: 'x' })` is **false** (`unrecognized_keys`), `{ ariaLabel: 'x' }` **true** — the alias is a spelling the contract **rejects**, so ⛔ nothing new can be authored in it.
- On the base tree, `record:path` read **only** the refused spelling, twice, through an `as any` cast. ⇒ before objectui#9935, the only spelling that worked on that block was the one the contract refuses.
- `record:quick_actions` read `aria?.ariaLabel ?? aria?.label` — the canonical first, the alias as a fold, placed there deliberately by **objectui#4663**.

## Governing text, read rather than recalled

`AGENTS.md` **#0.1** (objectui `origin/main`, read 2026-09-18T19:15:10Z), verbatim in part: 「do **not** add a lenient fallback/alias in the renderer … to make non-compliant metadata 'work.' A tolerant fallback fossilizes the wrong convention into a second de-facto contract, dilutes the spec, and hides the producer's bug — one strict contract beats N dialects.」

⚠️ It bears on this and ⛔ does not settle it: #0.1 governs **adding** an alias so that off-spec metadata works. This card asks about **retiring** one that may still be serving documents written before the contract closed — a case #0.1's text does not address.

<!-- os-decision-facets -->
os-decision-facets

- ① **项目长远合理性** — 退役消除一条"第二事实上契约",这正是 #0.1 的方向;保留则让一条**被契约拒绝**的拼写在渲染器里长期可读,而契约那边永远不会再接受它,两端说的话不一致会一直存在。
- ② **实际业务拉动** — ⛔ **未实测,且本仓测不了**:有没有存量文档仍以 `aria.label` 书写,要看租户文档,本仓无任何仪器有此触达(同一堵墙见 objectui#9916)。⇒ 这条轴上**两个方向都没有拉动证据**,退役的代价是"可能悄悄丢掉某个存量文档的可及名称",而这个"可能"⛔ 量不出来。
- ③ **防 AI 犯错** — 判据是「宽容恰是 AI 批量犯错被掩盖的温床」。⚠️ 但这里的宽容**够不到 AI**:契约在 publish 时就拒了这个拼写,所以 ⛔ 没有新的错误能从这条路进来。它能掩盖的只有**旧**文档,而旧文档已经写成了。⇒ 这条轴在此处**不像通常那样偏向收紧**,如实呈现。
- ④ **创业阶段不扩散** — 「废弃别名默认**立即退休**,不设分阶段窗口;staged 仅凭**具名外部用户证据**」。⛔ 本席没有具名外部用户证据,按字面这条轴指向**立即退役**。⚠️ 但它同时要推翻 objectui#4663 在一个**已发布渲染器**上钉住的显式决定,而推翻前卡的既定裁决是维护者的底线。

Prior rulings read: lenient fallback,tolerant fallback,second de-facto contract,one strict contract → 0 hits; none — and a second pass over `alias tolerance,consumer-side alias,back-compat fold,retire alias` also returned 0 ADR decisions (both read 2026-09-18T19:15Z). ⇒ ⛔ no accepted ADR decision answers this; `AGENTS.md` #0.1 is the nearest governing text and is quoted above rather than treated as an answer.

## Options

- **A — retire the fold on both blocks.** Canonical `ariaLabel` only, everywhere. One line, because the fold now lives in a single read point. Cost: reverses objectui#4663's pinned decision on a published renderer, and ⛔ silently drops the accessible name of any stored pre-contract document that still carries the alias.
- **B — keep the fold on those two, scoped back from the five.** Costs nothing an author can reach (the contract refuses the spelling), keeps objectui#4663 intact, and makes PR objectui#9935's changeset sentence true. Cost: a contract-refused spelling stays readable, which is the shape #0.1 exists to prevent even where it is currently harmless.

**Recommendation: B**, and ⚠️ this seat's recommendation differs from the delivering dev's, which was A.

Self-check — 只看①选 **A**(它是唯一消除第二事实上契约的);②③④ 是否翻转:② **不翻转但抽掉了 A 的底** —— 退役的唯一实际代价(丢掉存量文档的可及名称)⛔ 量不出来,而这是一条**可及性**代价,失败时用户是读屏用户、且**静默** · ③ **翻转** —— 这条轴的理由是"宽容掩盖 AI 的批量错误",而契约在 publish 拒了它,新错误进不来,所以这条轴在此处不支持 A · ④ **不翻转,但被维护者底线挡住** —— 字面指向立即退役,而执行它要推翻一张前卡钉住的运行时决定。⇒ **一轴翻转、一轴抽底、一轴被底线挡住,结论从 A 移到 B**;⛔ 若维护者认为 ④ 的字面优先于不可测的可及性代价,A 是完全站得住的,这也正是本卡送上来的原因。

Confidence gaps: ① ⛔ **未实测** —— 是否存在仍以 `aria.label` 书写的存量文档,本仓无仪器可答;② ⛔ 未实测 —— 若退役,受影响文档的数量级;③ 上列读数是**复核的**,本席逐条读了它的记录并核对了每个被引评论的 `issue_url`,但 ⛔ 没有独立重跑它的探针。

Refs: objectui#9556 (the card) · PR objectui#9935 (the delivery) · review record `5734967234` · objectui#4663 (the pinned decision A would reverse) · objectui#9916 (the same tenant-document wall on axis ②).
